shape: 4-portal cross arena (N + S + W + E gates) with central super-hub + perimeter chain
description: Four-portal arena with a SOUTH super-hub (4nw4xe at (12.30, 16.11), 6-way) that joins south_gate plus 5 interior anchors. The NW cluster (dkngk3 + tjh6gz west entry + k7tgqo) is a triangle near the west gate. The EAST cluster (ty6vle east-mid + mwz68d east-entry, plus 1skjqw on the south-east) joins via 4nw4xe AND ty6vle. A long PERIMETER CHAIN runs around the south and west: ty6vle → k6oip4 → u7zqie → k501rf (north) → daw2lp + 1ifdo9 + mwhatk (NW corner pocket) + 1kctoo (NW corner near spawn_north).

portals.south: spawn_south at (11.98, 24.19) — gate on the south (high-Z) side, east column
portals.north: spawn_north at (-16.60, -23.39) — gate on the north (low-Z) side, west column
portals.west: spawn_west at (-26.05, 16.41) — gate on the west (low-X) side
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.32, -2.98) — gate on the east (high-X) side, near midline

traversalNotes: Direct N→S: spawn_north → nw_entry → n_center → se_step_b → se_step_a → east_mid → south_inner → spawn_south. 7 hops via perimeter.
Direct N→E: spawn_north → nw_entry → n_center → se_step_b → se_step_a → east_mid → east_inner → spawn_east. 7 hops.
Direct S→W: spawn_south → south_inner → nw_cluster_c → west_inner → spawn_west. 4 hops.
Direct S→E: spawn_south → south_inner → east_inner → spawn_east. 3 hops.
Direct W→E: spawn_west → west_inner → nw_cluster_c → east_inner → spawn_east. 4 hops.
DISPATCH: south_inner is the 6-way south dispatcher; nw_cluster_c is the 5-way NW dispatcher.
NW PERIMETER CHAIN connects spawn_north to the south cluster — strict-backbone single chain along the north and west walls.
nw_pocket is a 1-degree dead-end forming a triangle with nw_step_a + nw_step_b.
